messages:
emma_cs: FYI — Vanguard Systems (VG-77) renewal in flight. Procurement submitted PO but requests Net-60, a 9-month term (instead of the quoted 12), and wants billing split across Vanguard UK + Vanguard DE. They also require customer-managed KMS and will provide a key ARN. Need legal & finance to confirm we can accept a single SOW signed by Vanguard UK with split invoices.

diego_rev: thanks emma. PO number: VG-PO-1188. do we have their DE VAT cert? procurement attached a scanned VAT cert but the legal name on the cert doesn't match the PO entity exactly. :thinking_face:

emma_cs: attaching the PO snippet: ```PO: VG-PO-1188
Total: $96,000 (split 60/40 UK/DE)
Term: 9 months
Billing: Net 60
KMS: customer-managed (they provided ARN)```

harper_fin: finance note: we can issue split invoices but need validated VAT and vendor mapping for the DE line before we release the EU invoice. Net-60 increases AR exposure but acceptable with credit check. I'll need the legal entity full name that matches the VAT doc.

marta_legal: legal view: single SOW signed by UK entity is allowable if we include an addendum that documents the invoice split and specifies tax/responsibility carveouts for the DE entity. if they refuse to sign the addendum, we may require signature from both entities. i'll draft addendum language and send to emma for review.

diego_rev: i'll ping procurement to confirm the exact legal name for DE entity and ask for a VAT registration printout. also confirming who will hold liability for DE taxes per their procurement policy.

emma_cs: procurement replied: "We confirm Vanguard DE (Vanguard GmbH) will not sign; UK signs master SOW. VAT reg attached as 'Vanguard GmbH - VAT cert.pdf'." they included a PO amendment specifying split 60/40.

harper_fin: received VAT cert. vendor code remains pending until addendum signed. we can prepare UK invoice now; we'll hold DE invoice until legal confirms liability language. marking account health: yellow — risk moderate due to net-60 + split billing.

marta_legal: addendum draft ready: includes invoice split clause, KMS onboarding responsibilities (customer supplies key ARN, Redwood will run verification test during onboarding window), acceptance criteria tied to enablement, and indemnity language for DE-specific taxes. sending to emma for customer review.

emma_cs: sent addendum to Vanguard procurement and asked them to confirm signatory for DE entity by EOD Thu. also requested a signed vendor affidavit. noting renewal price lock until EOM, otherwise they may ask to renegotiate.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 'Vanguard_SOW_Addendum_v1' created and awaiting attachments: 'PO_VG-PO-1188', 'Vanguard_GmbH_VAT_cert'.

diego_rev: procurement responded: "We accept addendum language. UK will sign master SOW + addendum. Vanguard GmbH will accept invoicing but will not sign. VAT/PO mapping confirmed." attaching their confirmation.

harper_fin: with confirmation and valid VAT doc we can provision vendor code and issue DE invoice once addendum is countersigned. removing hold on vendor mapping. scheduling AR follow-up for Net-60.

emma_cs: great — envelope sent. once countersigned i'll push final PO mapping to AR and schedule onboarding week-of-06/14. leaving thread open until both invoices posted. :white_check_mark:
